recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-25277 is historically applied but superseded for the current build by FHIR-44982, so no additional core source change is appropriate unless PHER reopens the datatype question.
issue_request: FHIR-25277 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested changing doseNumber and seriesDoses in Immunization, ImmunizationEvaluation, and ImmunizationRecommendation from positiveInt/string choices to string-only elements, while clarifying that Immunization reflects provider intent and the other two resources reflect CDS evaluation output.
initial_application: Commit c60c23462f1349890e3e14cc979075bad8e1ecc0 applied the original string-only change to the older spreadsheet and example sources. Later StructureDefinition source retained FHIR-25277 committee notes and string datatypes before subsequent resource and datatype changes.
additional_context: FHIR-44982 is a later Applied/Persuasive with Modification PHER decision for the same doseNumber and seriesDoses elements, changing them from string to CodeableConcept and allowing coded concepts or free text. The combined branch already contains Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-44982 at d71140d621d3265e4cb4df589b68e53706ef5a0a. Current core build scope keeps Immunization active but no longer has active ImmunizationEvaluation or ImmunizationRecommendation core resource directories.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reverting the current CodeableConcept datatype back to string would contradict the later final FHIR-44982 decision and the already-published FHIR-44982 reconciliation on the combined branch.
